patch.value: Scaffold fleet gates and certify packed consumers

Adapt pm-jev tooling; no scheduled release; full authored source coverage; documentation and duplication clean; npm and Bun release gates; npm/npx and native Bun/bunx packed installs; real public read-only acceptance.

value.author: pi-glm-quality
value.text: Plan: implement scripts/main-invocation.ts, scripts/docstring-gate.ts and a compact c8-based scripts/coverage-gate.ts (package.json coverageGate config; c8 --all include src+scripts+root entry, exclude tests/dist/node_modules; json-summary/json/lcov; report invalidation on start and failure; disk-inventory reconciliation against the summary). Cover scripts via test/tooling.test.ts (real child executions plus importable functions; c8 aggregates child coverage) and add test/install.acceptance.ts (pack allowlist, isolated npm+Bun consumers, real SDK temp trackers, npx/bunx registration). Review .github workflows against the scaffolded package; expected no-op since guards already reference PM_REVIEW_RELEASE_ENABLED and workflow_dispatch only.

value.author: codex-sol
value.text: Orchestrator adopted and verified the CLI worker drafts after the GLM quota check showed only four percent remaining. Further worker calls were stopped. Packed npm/npx and native Bun/bunx consumers both passed: allowlisted tarball, four command help surfaces, typed schema registration, offline precedent query and search in independent real trackers. Coverage and full release gates are still being completed.

value.author: codex-sol
value.text: Final quality receipts: fresh npm ci passed; both full npm and Bun gates and the isolated Git-identity full npm gate passed. Packed artifacts passed in independent npm/npx and native Bun/bunx workspaces. The fixture-backed transport and real tracker tests pass at unchanged 100/100/100/100 thresholds. Four development audit entries from one braces advisory remain tracked by pm-review-dev-audit; production audit is clean.

author: codex-sol
message: Orchestrator verified worker contributions and released the claim for review; item remains in progress.

value.author: codex-sol
value.text: Final acceptance hygiene correction: npm pack now receives a scratch HOME rather than the package directory, keeping package-manager logs and cache in the disposable consumer fixture. Runtime code and the packed allowlist are unchanged. Package-local caches remain ignored.

value.author: codex-sol
value.text: Final full-gate verification is complete at source commit 5fe85ac under npm, Bun and isolated Git identity. npm pack --dry-run lists 37 allowlisted files; packed consumer acceptance passes npm/npx and native Bun/bunx. SDK type-registration and normal-home global-extension version skew remain tracked by pm-review-sdk-gap; the four development audit entries from one underlying braces advisory remain tracked by pm-review-dev-audit. Release workflow remains dispatch-only and maintainer-disabled. Claims are released for orchestrator review; no items are closed.

value.author: codex-sol
value.text: Review round 1 confirms missing identity enforcement, broken release epic link, ignored eval queries, and root-source coverage glob. Add minimal behavioral regressions and independently revert each fix before recording proof.

value.author: codex-sol
value.text: Finding 4248463199: added identity-gate.ts to required CI and release checks. Real Git regression rejects unapproved author/committer identities, private home paths and side-branch history. Behavioral revert of auditIdentities to no enforcement fails identity policy rejects unapproved (exit 1); reverting only CI wiring fails identity policy runs as a required (exit 1).

value.author: codex-sol
value.text: Finding 4248463231: release PR body now links the existing pm-review-epic. node --test --test-name-pattern="release PR tracking link" test/tooling.test.ts passes; reverting only that link fails the same test (exit 1, missing tracked epic).

value.author: codex-sol
value.text: Finding 4248463257: removed parent search-directory ignore. Real Git check-ignore now includes eval-queries.json while excluding generated search files. node --test --test-name-pattern="Git includes eval queries" test/tooling.test.ts passes; reverting only the ignore fix fails (exit 1).

value.author: codex-sol
value.text: Finding 4248463262: root sources normalize to . and use **/*.ts. Real c8 fixture at 100/100/100/100 passes with sources=[.]. node --test --test-name-pattern="coverage gate measures repository-root" test/tooling.test.ts passes; reverting only inventorySources fails (exit 1, source absent from report).

value.author: codex-sol
value.text: Round 1 preliminary full coverage passes 82/82 tests, zero failures/cancellations/skips/todos, with 100/100/100/100 over all 17 configured authored source files. All eleven findings have targeted isolated revert proofs; identity enforcement also has a separate CI-wiring proof. Final committed-head npm, Bun, isolated-identity and Node 22 release checks follow.

value.author: codex-sol
value.text: Node 22 full release check uncovered a second acceptance fixture defect after the timeout fix: npm 10 runs prepare during npm pack --ignore-scripts, while source-package packing supplied an uninitialized consumer PM_PATH. Use the source package tracker for source packing; consumer install and command trackers remain isolated. The existing real packed npm/Bun acceptance is the regression.

value.author: codex-sol
value.text: Additional Node 22 acceptance correction: source packing uses the source PM tracker and parses the final npm JSON array after npm 10 prepare output. npm run test:install under Node 22.23.1/npm 10.9.8 passes 1/1 with both npm/npx and native Bun/bunx consumers. Reverting only the tracker coordinate fails with Tracker is not initialized (exit 1); reverting only JSON-prefix handling fails with SyntaxError (exit 1). No consumer scenario or lifecycle check was skipped.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Review round two takeover: inspect existing uncommitted tooling fixes, independently run one-change revert proofs, then full npm and Bun release gates. Preserve historical records and commit only explicit package-owned paths.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Independently verified tooling revert proofs: pack manifest parser, coverage root anchoring, and identity patch buffer each fail their focused behavioral regression with the one file reverted to HEAD (exit 1), then pass after byte-for-byte restoration (exit 0). Added an actual relative-root coverage CLI invocation alongside the deterministic runner regression.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: First linked npm release check correctly failed on require-atomic-updates in the added CLI-error regression. Replaced mutable shared test contexts with fresh contexts; no production change was needed. Rerunning the complete gate. Remaining dogfood UX is tracked by pm-review-summary-ux (static-analysis wrapper title) and pm-review-help-ux (host help placeholders).

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: The zero-duplication gate caught repeated test setup after the first lint correction. Consolidated the new expected-error assertions into the existing validation/network-boundary test, retaining its previous checks. Lint and duplication now pass at the unchanged zero threshold. The linked standalone core run reached its default 120-second timeout under concurrent host load; full release gates have a 2400-second budget and are still running.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Full npm gate reached changelog validation: all 85 coverage tests passed with no skips at 100 statements, branches, functions and lines across 17 authored sources; production audit reports zero vulnerabilities. Changelog entry ordering changed after PM mutations, so regenerating the checked changelog and rerunning both full gates. The five one-change revert proofs remain independently verified.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Final certification passed: npm run release:check and bun run release:check each exit 0 through linked PM test runs. Both cover 85 passing tests, no skips, 100 statements/branches/functions/lines over 17 authored sources, zero duplication, clean production audit, changelog, publish attestation and real packed npm/npx plus native Bun/bunx consumers. All five restored production hashes match. Evidence is in docs/review-round2.md; original scratch task/rules files remain unavailable. Remaining UX is tracked by pm-review-summary-ux and pm-review-help-ux.

value.author: claude-hub
value.text: CodeRabbit round 3 (identity gate, Major): the home-path pattern matched relative names such as a root-named source file or a root-cause document, because the root-home alternative only required a word boundary; any false positive fails every later gate run while the commit stays in the audited range. Extracted containsAbsoluteHomePath() anchored to path boundaries. Table test 'home-path detection is anchored to path boundaries' (10 detected, 7 ignored; fixtures built from string parts so the test itself adds no literal paths). Revert proof: restoring the old pattern fails on the root-named source file case.

value.author: claude-hub
value.text: CodeRabbit round 6 (release.yml merge loop, security): auto-resolution of release-PR review threads now requires every comment author to be an allowlisted review bot (coderabbitai), so code-scanning and other app findings are never silently resolved; each resolution is written to the step summary. Test 'release PR auto-resolution only touches threads written entirely by the allowlisted review bot' runs the workflow's own jq filter against review-bot, code-scanning, mixed-bot and human threads; removing the allowlist fails it. CHANGELOG regenerated with changelog:full (the check uses replace mode; prepend mode caused the previous CI failure).
